```{=typst}
#let acento = rgb("#1c5cab")
#let suave = rgb("#52514e")
#let tenue = rgb("#8a8984")

#set text(fill: rgb("#1a1a1a"), hyphenate: false)
#set par(justify: true, leading: 0.6em, spacing: 0.6em)
#set page(footer: context [
  #set text(7.5pt, fill: tenue)

])
#show link: set text(fill: acento)

#let seccion(titulo) = {
  v(14pt)
  block(below: 8pt, {
    text(10.5pt, weight: "bold", fill: acento, tracking: 0.08em, upper(titulo))
    v(-2pt)
    line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.7pt + acento)
  })
}

#let etiqueta(t) = box(
  inset: (x: 5pt, y: 2.5pt), radius: 3pt, fill: acento.lighten(90%),
  text(7.5pt, fill: acento.darken(10%), t)
)

#let entrada(fecha, titulo, lugar, cuerpo: none, tags: ()) = block(breakable: false, below: 11pt,
  grid(
    columns: (3.1cm, 1fr), column-gutter: 12pt,
    { set par(justify: false); align(right, text(8.5pt, fill: suave, weight: "medium", fecha)) },
    {
      text(weight: "bold", titulo)
      linebreak()
      text(fill: acento, lugar)
      if cuerpo != none {
        v(3pt)
        cuerpo
      }
      if tags.len() > 0 {
        v(3pt)
        tags.map(etiqueta).join(h(4pt))
      }
    }
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
cv <- yaml::read_yaml("datos/cv.yml")

# Convierte texto R en un string literal de Typst
s <- function(x) paste0('"', gsub('"', '\\\\"', gsub("\\\\", "\\\\\\\\", x)), '"')
typst <- function(...) cat("```{=typst}\n", ..., "\n```\n\n", sep = "")

# Encabezado
contactos <- vapply(cv$contacto, \(c) paste0("link(", s(c$enlace), ", ", s(c$texto), ")"), "")
typst(
  '#block(below: 12pt, text(24pt, weight: "bold", ', s(cv$nombre), '))\n',
  '#text(11.5pt, fill: acento, weight: "medium", ', s(cv$titulo), ')\\\n',
  '#text(9.5pt, fill: suave, ', s(cv$subtitulo), ')\n',
  '#v(6pt)\n',
  '#text(9pt, (', paste(contactos, collapse = ", "), ').join(text(fill: tenue, "  ·  ")))\n',
  '#v(4pt)\n#line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.4pt + rgb("#d9d8d4"))'
)

# Perfil
typst('#seccion("Perfil")\n#text(', s(cv$perfil), ')')

# Experiencia
typst('#seccion("Experiencia laboral")')
for (e in cv$experiencia) {
  tags <- paste0("(", paste0(vapply(e$herramientas, s, ""), collapse = ", "), ",)")
  typst(
    "#entrada(", s(e$fecha), ", ", s(e$cargo), ", ", s(e$organizacion),
    ", cuerpo: text(", s(e$descripcion), "), tags: ", tags, ")"
  )
}

# Formación
typst('#seccion("Formación")')
for (f in cv$formacion) {
  typst("#entrada(", s(f$fecha), ", ", s(f$titulo), ", ", s(f$institucion), ")")
}

# Habilidades, en una grilla de dos columnas
celdas <- vapply(cv$habilidades, \(h) paste0(
  '[#text(weight: "bold", ', s(h$grupo), ') #v(2pt) #(',
  paste0(vapply(h$items, s, ""), collapse = ", "), ',).map(etiqueta).join(h(4pt))]'
), "")
typst(
  '#seccion("Habilidades")\n',
  '#block(breakable: false, grid(columns: (1fr, 1fr), column-gutter: 16pt, row-gutter: 12pt, ',
  paste(celdas, collapse = ", "), '))'
)
```
